title: Calibration Diagnostic Charge Acceptance: Calibration Workmanship Warranty Desk Card
content:
**When the charge arises.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, an inspection that finds a calibration fault not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty posts one calibration diagnostic charge for that concern, in the amount figured for that charge, and every other inspection stays free, whether it finds the concern covered or finds not covered a concern of a kind on which the plan charges no diagnostic fee.

| Inspection outcome on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty coverage | Charge |
|---|---|
| A calibration fault found not covered | one calibration diagnostic charge for that concern |
| A concern found covered | none; the inspection is free |
| A concern of a kind on which the plan charges no diagnostic fee, found not covered | none; the inspection is free |

The charge is booked on the coverage's customer charges account, so that it stands on the coverage's account as owed by the customer.

## The action: `accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72`

**Capability.** The customer accepts the calibration diagnostic charge for a calibration-fault concern that a network inspection found not covered under their Calibration Workmanship Warranty. Accepting books one diagnostic charge for that concern on the coverage's customer charges account, dated today, so the amount becomes owed by the customer and shows on the coverage's money history as a diagnostic charge naming the concern.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_calibration_diagnostic_charge_d9578b72` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to accept the charge.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_coverage_id` | Reference number of the Calibration Workmanship Warranty coverage the inspected concern belongs to, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup | text reference number |
| `concern_number` | Ordinal of the inspected concern on that coverage, exactly as shown on the concern's report and inspection entries | integer, 1 or more |
| `amount_usd` | The diagnostic charge the customer accepts | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "booked", `warranty_entry_id` (the new charge entry's reference number), `warranty_coverage_id` (the coverage charged), `concern_number`, `amount_usd` (the amount booked, 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD). The receipt's reference number confirms the charge is booked.

Q. Does an inspection that finds the calibration fault covered post a calibration diagnostic charge?
A. No. Every inspection other than one finding a calibration fault not covered under a Calibration Workmanship Warranty stays free.
